args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary - Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods, "Retail returns logistics"): Weekly issue highlighting trends in retail returns handling, linking to a feature article on logistics costs.
- Linked article: Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%; retailers using consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about 20%.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned apparel within 10 days of receipt preserves most of its original margin, underscoring the value of fast resale cycles alongside hub consolidation.
